items: Keep the thermostat at 55°F or higher
Shut off the main water valve
Put a few lamps on light timers
Have someone check inside every few days
cta_head: Let MyHome keep an eye on things.
cta_sub: Property oversight while you travel. Call or text 317-440-9258.
